title: Transform to Vastrado-style e-commerce with theme switcher

requirements.summary: Display large centered DoRaa Sangam House logo in elegant gold font on dark background at the top center of the post-login home page
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is centered horizontally at the top of the page
Logo uses elegant gold color (#D4AF37 or antique gold from theme) on dark background
Logo is prominently sized and visible on all viewport sizes

file_operations.description: Add a large centered DoRaa Sangam House logo at the top of the page using the generated logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/logo-doraa-sangam.dim_1200x400.png. Style with prominent size, elegant gold coloring, and centered horizontal alignment. Ensure visibility across all viewport sizes with responsive sizing.

requirements.summary: Add horizontal category navigation bar with Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All categories styled with cyan/teal buttons and golden hover glow, scrollable on mobile
acceptanceCriteria: Five category buttons are displayed in a horizontal row below the logo
Buttons use cyan/teal color (#14b8a6 or similar)
Buttons display golden glow effect on hover
On mobile viewports, the category bar scrolls horizontally
All categories are visible and clickable

file_operations.description: Create a horizontal category navigation component displaying five categories: Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All. Style buttons with cyan/teal background (#14b8a6), apply golden glow hover effects using existing useGoldRipple hook or CSS box-shadow. Implement horizontal scroll on mobile using overflow-x-scroll with hidden scrollbar. Make buttons accessible and keyboard-navigable.
Import and render CategoryNavigationBar component below the DoRaa Sangam House logo. Position it prominently in the layout hierarchy before the product grid section.

requirements.summary: Add user profile/dashboard icon in top right corner that opens user dashboard when clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Profile icon is positioned in the top right corner of the navigation area
Icon is circular and styled consistently with the luxury theme
Clicking the icon opens the user dashboard
Icon has golden hover glow effect matching other interactive elements

file_operations.description: Add a circular profile/dashboard icon button in the top right area of the header navigation. Style with luxury theme colors and apply golden hover glow effect. Wire the icon to navigate to /dashboard using the existing navigation system. Ensure the icon is visible and accessible on all viewport sizes.

requirements.summary: Display product grid with saree cards showing on-model images, name, price, discount badge, Add to Cart button with 16px curved corners and hover lift animation with golden border glow
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards are displayed in a responsive grid layout below the category navigation
Each card shows product image, name, price, discount badge, and Add to Cart button
Cards have 16px border radius and subtle box shadow
On hover, cards animate with a lift effect and golden border glow
Product images show sarees on models
Grid is responsive and adjusts column count based on viewport width

file_operations.description: Update ProductCard component to display 16px border radius, subtle box-shadow, and hover lift animation with golden border glow effect. Ensure card shows product image with on-model sarees, product name, price, discount percentage badge (calculated using existing formatters), and Add to Cart button. Verify animation respects reduced motion preferences.

Add a responsive product grid below the CategoryNavigationBar displaying product cards using the existing ProductCard component. Use grid layout with responsive column counts (1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3-4 columns desktop). Fetch products using existing useQueries hooks and display them in the grid with proper loading and error states.

requirements.summary: Add optional hero banner with full-width saree showcase image and overlay text 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'
acceptanceCriteria: Hero banner spans full width above the product grid
Banner displays a saree showcase image
Text overlay reads 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'
Text is readable with proper contrast against the background
Banner is responsive on all device sizes

file_operations.description: Create a full-width hero banner component displaying a saree showcase image as background with text overlay reading 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'. Use one of the generated product images (frontend/public/assets/generated/product-banarasi.dim_800x1000.png or similar) as the showcase background. Ensure text has proper contrast with backdrop blur or gradient overlay. Make banner responsive with adjusted height and text size on mobile.
Import and render HeroBanner component at the top of the product grid section, positioned after CategoryNavigationBar and before the product cards grid.

requirements.summary: Create user dashboard page with Profile, Orders, Addresses tabs and editable profile information with save functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard opens when profile icon is clicked
Three tabs are visible and selectable: Profile, Orders, Addresses
Profile tab displays editable fields for name, email, and phone
Save button updates user profile data in the backend
Dashboard page uses clean, premium styling consistent with the luxury theme

file_operations.description: Ensure DashboardPage component has three clearly visible and selectable tabs: Profile, Orders, and Addresses. Verify the Profile tab displays editable input fields for name, email, and phone number with a save button that calls the existing saveCallerUserProfile backend function. Apply clean premium styling consistent with the royal Banarasi luxury theme using existing theme colors and shadows.
Verify that the /dashboard route is properly registered and navigable. Ensure that clicking the profile icon in the Header component navigates to this route.

requirements.summary: Add Theme Switcher in dashboard with Dark, Light, System options saving choice to localStorage and applying on page load
acceptanceCriteria: Theme switcher is visible in the user dashboard
Three selectable options are displayed: Dark, Light, System
Dark theme uses #0B0E0C background with white text
Light theme uses #F8F9FA background with #1A1A1A text
System option detects and follows OS prefers-color-scheme setting
Selected theme is saved to localStorage
Theme is applied immediately on selection
Theme persists across page reloads and sessions

file_operations.description: Create a custom hook using useLocalStorageState to manage theme state with three options: 'dark', 'light', 'system'. Implement logic to detect system theme using window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') when 'system' is selected. Return current effective theme, setTheme function, and selected theme preference. Apply theme by adding/removing CSS classes or data attributes on document root element.

Create a theme switcher component that displays three selectable options (Dark, Light, System) using radio buttons or segmented control. Wire to useTheme hook to read and update theme preference. Style with premium luxury aesthetic using existing theme colors and provide clear visual feedback for the selected option.
Import and render ThemeSwitcher component within the Profile tab or as a dedicated Theme section in the dashboard. Position it prominently so users can easily find and interact with theme settings.

Add CSS variable definitions for light theme colors: --background: #F8F9FA, --foreground: #1A1A1A for light mode. Define theme-specific color variables under [data-theme='light'] or .light-theme selector. Ensure dark theme maintains existing colors with --background: #0B0E0C and --foreground: white. Apply these variables throughout the stylesheet for backgrounds, text, borders, and UI elements.

Import and initialize useTheme hook at the App component level to apply theme on initial load. Ensure theme class or data attribute is applied to the root element so CSS variables take effect globally across the entire application.

requirements.summary: Ensure light theme maintains clean readability with proper contrast ratios while preserving premium luxury aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: All text in light theme has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA minimum)
Buttons and interactive elements are clearly visible in light theme
Golden hover effects are visible against light backgrounds
Light theme maintains premium, luxury visual styling
No readability issues or visual glitches in light mode

file_operations.description: Review and adjust light theme color variables to ensure WCAG AA contrast ratios for all text and interactive elements. Define light-theme-specific variants for gold hover effects that remain visible on light backgrounds (darker gold or gold with increased opacity). Test button, link, and card styles for proper visibility and contrast in light mode. Preserve luxury aesthetic by using refined color palettes and maintaining elegant spacing and shadows.

Add or adjust Tailwind theme configuration to support light theme variants for custom colors, shadows, and effects. Ensure golden hover effects (box-shadow, border-color) have sufficient contrast against light backgrounds by defining theme-specific variants.

requirements.summary: Apply golden hover glow effects consistently across all buttons, icons, and interactive elements in both themes
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons display golden glow on hover
All icons display golden glow on hover
Hover effects work in both dark and light themes
Glow effect is smooth and consistent across all interactive elements

file_operations.description: Define global CSS classes for golden hover glow effects that work in both dark and light themes. Use box-shadow with gold color (#D4AF37 or theme variable) and adjust opacity/color for light theme visibility. Apply transition properties for smooth hover animations. Create reusable utility classes like .gold-hover-glow that can be applied to buttons and icons throughout the app.

Apply golden hover glow effects to all interactive elements in the header including navigation links, profile icon, cart icon, and authentication buttons. Use existing useGoldRipple hook or apply CSS classes for consistent hover styling.
Ensure all category navigation buttons have golden hover glow effects applied consistently. Verify effects work smoothly in both dark and light themes.
Apply golden hover glow to product card borders and action buttons (Add to Cart, wishlist, quick view). Ensure hover effects are smooth and consistent across all interactive elements within the card.

requirements.summary: Ensure full responsive design with horizontal scrolling categories on mobile and adaptive product grid layout
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports (< 768px), category navigation scrolls horizontally
Logo remains centered on all screen sizes
Product grid displays 1-2 columns on mobile devices
All elements are usable and properly sized on mobile
No horizontal overflow or layout breakage on small screens

file_operations.description: Implement horizontal scroll behavior for mobile viewports using overflow-x-scroll with snap-scroll functionality. Hide scrollbar visually while maintaining functionality. Test on mobile breakpoints (< 768px) to ensure smooth scrolling and proper touch interaction.

Ensure logo remains centered using flex or grid centering techniques across all viewport sizes. Adjust logo size responsively (larger on desktop, smaller on mobile). Configure product grid with responsive column counts: grid-cols-1 on mobile, grid-cols-2 on small tablets, grid-cols-3 on tablets, grid-cols-4 on desktop. Test for horizontal overflow and fix any layout breakage on small screens.

Add responsive utility classes and media queries to support mobile-first design. Ensure base font sizes, spacing, and component dimensions scale appropriately across breakpoints. Add overflow-hidden to body if necessary to prevent horizontal scrolling issues.

requirements.summary: Require authentication for dashboard and cart actions with login prompt for unauthenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users cannot access the dashboard
Clicking profile icon when not logged in shows login prompt or redirects to login
Cart actions require authentication
After successful login, users are redirected to their intended destination
Login prompt is clear and user-friendly

file_operations.description: Update profile icon click handler to check authentication status using existing useInternetIdentity hook. If user is not authenticated, redirect to /login with return path set to /dashboard using existing flash message and return path utilities. Display clear messaging indicating login is required.

Add authentication check before executing Add to Cart action. If user is not authenticated, display login prompt using existing toast system or redirect to login page with appropriate return path. Ensure cart actions are gated by authentication status.

Verify existing ProtectedRoute wrapper or add authentication guard at component level. Redirect unauthenticated users to /login with return path set to /dashboard. Use existing useAuthRedirect or useInternetIdentity hooks for authentication checks.

requirements.summary: Preserve all existing functionality including Internet Identity, OTP login, cart operations, and category carousel without regressions
acceptanceCriteria: Internet Identity login flow works without issues
OTP authentication flow remains functional
Shopping cart add/update/remove operations work correctly
Existing category carousel (if present) continues to function
No blank screens or JavaScript errors occur
All existing features remain operational after the transformation

file_operations.description: Ensure all existing routes and authentication flows remain intact. Verify Internet Identity provider wrapper, OTP login routes, and cart-related routes are not disrupted by the new home page layout changes. Test for JavaScript errors and blank screens during navigation between old and new features.

Preserve any existing category carousel components by ensuring they coexist with the new CategoryNavigationBar without conflicts. If an existing carousel is present, determine if it should remain or be replaced based on the new design requirements. Ensure no functionality is lost during the layout transformation.

Verify that cart operations (add, update, remove) remain functional and that localStorage persistence continues to work correctly. Ensure no regressions are introduced by new authentication guards or layout changes.

requirements.summary: Use five generated product images showing sarees on models in the product grid with 800x1000 dimensions
acceptanceCriteria: Five product images are generated and placed in frontend/public/assets/generated
Each image shows a saree worn by a model
Images have 800x1000 pixel dimensions
Images represent visually distinct saree styles (Banarasi, silk, organza, etc.)
Images are used in product cards on the home page grid

file_operations.description: Wire the five generated product images into the product grid by referencing their workspace file paths: frontend/public/assets/generated/product-banarasi.dim_800x1000.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-silk.dim_800x1000.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-organza.dim_800x1000.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-georgette.dim_800x1000.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/product-kalamkari.dim_800x1000.png. These images should be displayed in the product cards grid as static assets representing different saree styles on models.

Ensure ProductCard component can display product images from the frontend/public/assets/generated directory using the correct relative paths. Verify image aspect ratio handling for 800x1000 pixel dimensions and apply appropriate object-fit styling for consistent card appearance.
